title: Get Hook
description: Retrieves the details of a specific webhook using its ID.
content:
# Get Hook

## Usage

<CodeVariant
language="TypeScript"
title="TypeScript Example"
code={`import  from 'v0-sdk'

const result = await v0.hooks.getById({
hookId: '123',
})

console.log(result)`}
/>

<CodeVariant
language="cURL"
title="cURL Example"
code={`curl -X GET https://api.v0.dev/v1/hooks/123 \
-H "Authorization: Bearer $V0_API_KEY" \
-H "Content-Type: application/json"`}
/>

## API Signature

### Request

#### Path Parameters

<APISignature
title=""
parameters={[
{
"name": "hookId",
"type": "string",
"required": true,
"description": "The unique identifier of the hook to retrieve."
}
]}
/>
